title: Remove Greg's quotes and conversation history from TermAl's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; keep the rules, move provenance to tracker notes
outcome: TermAl's CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md state their rules concisely without Greg's quoted words or the history of how each rule was agreed; every removed quote and source is preserved verbatim in a tracker note, and no rule's authority, condition or scope changes.
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md contain no quotations of Greg and no conversation or relay history (mailbox numbers, dates of his words, who relayed them); each affected rule keeps exactly its operational meaning: what is allowed, by whom, under which conditions.
Every removed quote and its source is recorded verbatim on this item's notes before landing, grouped by the rule it came from, so provenance stays auditable.

The authority-file rule is met: both coordinators concur on the exact diff (no widening, only clarifying), Greg is sent the change and its consequence, the final-diff audit passes; a normal candidate with a clean review pair and full gate; no test reads or pins the instruction files.
